cards.name: Kindle
cards.face: Projectiles ignite enemies: +0.5 burn DPS, 2s
cards.detail: Projectiles ignite enemies (+0.5 burn DPS, 2s). Bosses and mini-bosses take 50% less Burn damage.

cards.name: Forge Breath
cards.face: +25% Fire damage.
cards.detail: Boosts Burn, Ember Burst, Everglow, and Inferno Crown damage.

cards.name: Ember Burst
cards.face: Kills explode for 25% damage in a medium radius

cards.name: Crucible
cards.face: Kindle hits stack Burn on an enemy, up to 5x
cards.detail: Kindle hits build Burn to 5 stacks, adding at most 1 stack every 3s per enemy. Each stack deals full Burn damage. When Burn ends, its damage stops and stacks fade one every 2s. Reignite the enemy to preserve its remaining stacks.

cards.name: Static
cards.face: +15% attack speed

cards.name: Chain Lightning
cards.face: Hits chain to 1 nearby enemy at 50% damage
cards.detail: Each jump strikes a different enemy. T2 and T3 lose damage per jump, compounding (75% / 85% of the hit before). T4: hits chain to 4 additional enemies with no damage falloff. Chain Current adds one more jump. Hits on bosses never chain, and jumps never strike bosses.

tiers.face: Hits chain to 1 nearby enemy at 50% damage
Chains to 4 with no damage falloff

cards.name: Surge
cards.face: +10% move, +20% shot speed, +10% attack speed

cards.name: Overload
cards.face: Hits have a 20% chance to stun for 1s
cards.detail: Hits have a 20% chance to stun enemies for 1s. Chain Lightning hits can also trigger this effect. With maxed Chain Lightning: 35% stun chance and 2s stun duration. An enemy can't be stunned again for 3s after a stun ends. Mini-bosses are stunned for 0.25s, or 0.5s with maxed Chain Lightning. Arena bosses are immune.

cards.name: Lightning Sentry
cards.face: Deploy a Tesla coil that shocks enemies
cards.detail: Deploy a Tesla coil near you that shocks enemies in range for 50% of your attack damage. T4 Lightning Network: merge your coils into one central coil with arena-wide coverage. Each shock deals 75% of your attack damage.

tiers.face: Deploy a Tesla coil that shocks enemies

cards.name: Electro Pulse
cards.face: Moving: every 3s, shock the nearest enemy
cards.detail: While moving, pulse every 3s: a static shock arcs to the nearest enemy for 40% damage. It can trigger Chain Lightning.

cards.name: Bloodthirsty
cards.face: Primary hits: 50% chance to Bleed: 10% ATK/0.5s, 3s
cards.detail: Primary hits have a 50% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing 10% ATK every 0.5s for 3s. Reapplying Bleed refreshes its duration without stacking damage or delaying the next tick. Bosses and mini-bosses take 50% less Bleed damage.

cards.name: Gouge
cards.face: +10% critical hit chance

cards.name: Hemorrhage
cards.face: Critical hits deal 3x damage instead of 2x

cards.name: Frenzy
cards.face: Kill a bleeding foe: +15% attack speed for 4s
cards.detail: Killing a bleeding enemy grants +15% attack speed for 4s. Further qualifying kills reset the duration. An enemy counts as bleeding only if it was already bleeding before the killing hit.

cards.name: Berserk
cards.face: +0.5% attack speed per 1% HP missing
cards.detail: Gain attack speed as health falls: +0.5% for every 1% of max HP missing.

cards.name: Siphon
cards.face: Kills restore 1 HP.

cards.name: Sanguinarian
cards.face: Kills grant Blood Barrier: 20% of the finishing hit
cards.detail: Kills grant Blood Barrier equal to 20% of the finishing hit's damage (at least 1), excluding overkill. Barrier absorbs damage before health, up to 50% of max HP. It expires 4s after the last positive gain. With Siphon: Siphon's overhealing becomes Blood Barrier.

cards.name: Brace
cards.face: Survive one lethal hit.
cards.detail: Survive one lethal hit (triggers at 0 HP). Brace saves you first, Unbroken Core second — never both on one hit.

cards.name: Repulse
cards.face: Projectiles knock enemies back
cards.detail: Projectiles knock enemies back 20pt (T2: 60pt). T3: they are launched up to 400pt instead, and each one damages up to 3 enemies it crashes into for 25% ATK. Walls stop them. Mini-bosses are only knocked back 20pt; bosses and snowmen can't be moved.

tiers.face: Knocked enemies fly and bowl others over

cards.name: Harden
cards.face: Collision radius −30%. Enemies bounce off you
cards.detail: Your collision radius shrinks 30%. Enemies that touch you are shoved 40pt away. The bounce never hurts you, but a bounced enemy can come back.

cards.name: Fortify
cards.face: Stand still: +2 DEF per second (max 30)
cards.detail: Standing still grants +1 temporary DEF every 0.5s, up to +30. Any movement resets it.

cards.name: Warp Shot
cards.face: Slow shots that speed up. Slower = more damage.
cards.detail: Your primary shots launch at 40% speed and reach full speed after 0.6s. They deal 150% damage at launch, falling to 100% at full speed. No effect on Rapid Fire's chaos beam. Damage between whole numbers rounds up by chance.

cards.name: Gravity Well
cards.face: Spent shots leave a pull zone (1s)
cards.detail: Primary shots that reach max range or hit a wall leave a pull zone for 1s. Pull zones count as black holes for your Void synergies.

cards.name: Phase
cards.face: Primary hits add Anomaly. Triggers at 4 stacks.
cards.detail: Primary hits apply Anomaly. At 4 stacks, normal enemies are erased; elites take 20% max HP damage and bosses take 3%. Triggering Anomaly clears its stacks. Elites and bosses cannot gain new stacks for 2s afterward. Elites are mini-bosses. T2: your shots ignore Braceguard shields and the Boss Mode flat DEF setting. It does not bypass other defenses.

tiers.face: Primary hits add Anomaly. Triggers at 4 stacks.
Each primary hit applies 2 Anomaly stacks.

cards.name: Devour
cards.face: XP orbs are pulled to you from 2x range.

cards.name: Void Horror
cards.face: Primary hits may make enemies flee.
cards.detail: Primary hits have an 8% chance to make enemies flee for 0.5s (elites 0.25s). Afterward, they resist fear for 2s. Bosses are immune.

cards.name: Shadow Edge
cards.face: Every 7th volley also fires a shadow blade.
cards.detail: Every 7th primary volley also fires a wide shadow blade. It deals 125% damage, strikes up to 3 enemies, and carries Void affinity, so Braceguard shields can't halve it. It is not a shot or a primary hit.

cards.name: Frost Touch
cards.face: Projectiles slow enemies 25% for 2s
cards.detail: T3: Iceburst shards and icicle fragments apply Frost Touch on hit. T3 requires Polar Vortex.

tiers.face: Shards apply it too (with Polar Vortex)

cards.name: Ice Shard
cards.face: +30% projectile speed

cards.name: Permafrost
cards.face: Hits deal +25% to slowed enemies
cards.detail: Your projectiles and Red Smile sweeps deal 25% more damage to slowed enemies, whatever slowed them. Damage between whole numbers rounds up by chance.

cards.name: Glacial Drift
cards.face: Leave a chill trail that slows enemies
cards.detail: Trail time is per patch of ground. T4's frozen ground lasts for the arena. T5 Ice Rink: freeze the arena, slowing non-boss enemies by 50% and increasing your movement speed by 25%. Replaces your chill trail. Requires Whiteout.

tiers.face: Leave a chill trail that slows enemies (2s)

cards.name: Glacial Spikes
cards.face: Chilled ground can impale enemies (4%/s)
cards.detail: Enemies on chilled ground have a 4% chance each second to be impaled. Executes normal enemies; deals 20% max HP to elites or 3% to bosses. At most one spike triggers every 0.75s across the arena.

cards.name: Swift
cards.face: +8% movement speed
cards.detail: Permanent movement speed: +8%, then +20%, then +35% (totals). Adds to your other movement bonuses.

cards.name: Rapid Fire
cards.face: +10% attack speed
cards.detail: Attack speed: +10%, then +25%, +50%, +90% (totals). Tier 5 turns your shots into a continuous chaos beam: it pierces enemies, stops at walls, and deals 75% of your shot damage every 0.5s, scaled up by all your attack speed. Scatter and Fracture split the beam. Warp Shot and Mirror Edge don't affect the beam; Erasure's Echo re-fires each beam lane as a normal shot. Can't be combined with Polar Vortex's icicle.

cards.name: Long Shot
cards.face: +25% shot range
cards.detail: Shot range: +25%, then +50% (totals). Tier 3: shots never expire by distance. Tier 4: unlimited range, and shots pierce every enemy and pass through walls and terrain. Adds to your other range bonuses.

tiers.face: No limit; pierce all, pass walls

cards.name: XP Boost
cards.face: +25% XP gain
cards.detail: Run XP gain: +25%, then +50% (totals). The run's level cap is 15; tier 3 raises it to 20 and grants one full level-up right away (card and stat), keeping the XP you have. XP collected at the cap is banked.

cards.name: Scatter
cards.face: 2 parallel shots per volley
cards.detail: Every volley fires 2 parallel shots, then 3 (center and one to each side), then 5, then 9 across a wide fan. Each is a full-strength shot with all your shot effects. Storm Engine's bonus pellets add lanes to the same pattern.

cards.name: Overcharge
cards.face: +5% damage/s unhit, max +50%. Resets on hit
cards.detail: Gain +5% damage each second without taking a hit, up to +50%. Taking a hit resets the bonus.

cards.name: Magnetic Core
cards.face: +15% XP pull; XP gives a speed burst
cards.detail: XP orbs are pulled from 15% / 30% / 50% farther (totals). Each XP orb collected grants +10% / +20% / +30% movement speed for 1.5s; another pickup refreshes the time, never the strength. Health orbs are never magnetized.

cards.name: Chain Reaction
cards.face: Enemies explode on death
cards.detail: Every enemy that dies explodes, hitting enemies within 35 range, then 50, then 70, for 1, then 2, then 3 damage. Enemies a blast kills explode too. Tier 3: each link down a chain adds +10% blast damage, up to +100%. Mini-bosses take half; the arena boss is unaffected. Blast kills give XP but no other on-kill effects.

tiers.face: Blasts deal 2 in a wider radius

cards.name: Glass Engine
cards.face: +100% attack speed, -50% max HP

cards.name: Phase Skin
cards.face: Ignore the next hit and gain 1s invulnerability (3.5s cd)

cards.name: Execution Protocol
cards.face: 2x damage to enemies below 30% HP

cards.name: Unstable Core
cards.face: Every 4s, a burst hurts nearby enemies and you
cards.detail: Every 4s, deal 2 damage to enemies within 60pt. Each burst also costs you 10 HP minus your DEF (at least 1). With nothing in range, it can't hurt you.

cards.name: Static Crown
cards.face: Level-ups release an expanding electro pulse
cards.detail: Level-ups release an electro pulse that expands from you for 4s, dealing 150% damage to each enemy the ring passes.

cards.name: Open Vein
cards.face: Bleeding enemies burst on death
cards.detail: Enemies that were already bleeding when they die burst, dealing 2 damage to nearby enemies.

cards.name: Iron Bloom
cards.face: Every 4s, iron spikes deal 50% DEF around you
cards.detail: Every 4s, iron spikes strike every enemy within 70pt for 50% of your current DEF (at least 1). Piercing: ignores flat enemy DEF. Walls block the spikes.

cards.name: Aegis
cards.face: Astral shield: take 25% less damage
cards.detail: T1: take 25% less damage. T2: enemies that touch you bounce 40pt and take spikes for 50% of your current DEF. T3: 35% less damage; they bounce 70pt and the spikes deal 75% DEF. Shares the 90% damage-reduction cap.

tiers.face: Melee attackers bounce off and take spikes
Bigger shield: 35% less damage, harder spikes

cards.name: Terra
cards.face: Cultivate the arena. Your ground mends you. Unlock Growth cards.

cards.name: Thornsoil
cards.face: Cultivated ground wounds what walks on it

cards.name: Rich Soil
cards.face: Your cultivated ground spreads wider and mends you harder

cards.name: Deeproot
cards.face: Rooted and sturdy: gain DEF while standing on cultivated ground

cards.name: Tree
cards.face: Plant a sapling. Help it become a problem.

tiers.face: Sapling — a tree takes root in your garden, and the ground grows
Rootreach — you move faster while standing on cultivated ground
Shelter — you slowly heal while standing on cultivated ground
Wild Domain — the Tree matures; your territory swells
The Forest Wakes — the NATURE CANON fires woodland animals at your enemies

cards.name: Vine Wall
cards.face: A thorny hedge rings your cultivated ground, repelling the swarm

tiers.face: A thorny hedge rings your cultivated ground, repelling the swarm
The bramble shoves harder — the swarm barely gets a foot in
The hedge thickens, catching enemy shots that cross it

cards.name: Seed Spore Shot
cards.face: Your shots seed enemies; a seeded enemy bursts into spores when it dies

tiers.face: Your shots seed enemies; a seeded enemy bursts into spores when it dies
Spores can re-seed the enemies they strike — the bloom spreads

cards.name: Wildbloom
cards.face: Grow a defensive flower on your cultivated ground

tiers.face: Grow a defensive flower on your cultivated ground
Grow a second flower — the garden bares its thorns
Grow a third flower — the whole bed is watching

cards.name: Null Bloom
cards.face: Kills may leave small black holes.
cards.detail: 30% of kills leave a small black hole for 0.8s. It pulls enemies in, and your Void synergies upgrade it like any black hole.

cards.name: Hoarfrost
cards.face: Regenerate 5 HP every 7s

cards.name: Whiteout
cards.face: Hits have a 12% chance to make a snowman (3s)
cards.detail: Hits have a 12% chance to turn an enemy into a snowman for 3s (elites for half as long). Each enemy can transform once every 10s. T3: damaging a snowman melts it. Normal enemies die instantly; elites take an additional 20% of max HP as damage. Bosses cannot become snowmen.

tiers.face: Hits have a 12% chance to make a snowman (3s)
Damaging a snowman melts it: normals die

cards.name: Cauterize
cards.face: Below 25% HP: heal 5 HP every 3s
cards.detail: While below 25% max HP, recover 5 HP every 3s. Leaving this threshold resets the timer.

cards.name: Relay Burn
cards.face: Burning foes can arc Shock
cards.detail: Each burning enemy arcs Shock roughly once a second to the nearest other enemy within 90pt, dealing 4 damage. Arcs don't chain.

cards.name: Overclock
cards.face: Level-ups: a 3s overdrive
cards.detail: After each level-up, when play resumes: +35% movement speed, +35% attack speed and +15% damage for 3 seconds of play. Another level-up refreshes the time; it never stacks.

cards.name: Dead Circuit
cards.face: Black holes grow as they feed, then burst.
cards.detail: Your black holes last 50% longer and damage enemies inside. Each enemy killed inside one, or hostile projectile it absorbs, makes it grow. At 3, it collapses in a void burst for 150% ATK. Requires Gravity Well or Null Bloom.

cards.name: Grounded Core
cards.face: In combat, stand still: +1 DEF per 7.5s (max 30)
cards.detail: Each uninterrupted 7.5s standing still in combat grants +1 DEF, permanent for the run (up to +30). Moving or leaving combat resets progress toward the next point.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.face: Kill a bleeding foe: +0.1% attack speed, max +30%
cards.detail: Killing a bleeding enemy permanently grants +0.1% attack speed this run, up to +30%.

cards.name: Riftline
cards.face: Shots pierce 2 enemies (3 hits). +25% range.
cards.detail: Shots pass through up to 2 enemies, so each shot can hit up to 3. Each enemy after the first takes 75% of the previous hit's damage (100% → 75% → 56%). +25% projectile range.

cards.name: Mirror Edge
cards.face: Shots have a 35% chance to echo for 50% damage.
cards.detail: Each primary shot has a 35% chance to fire again 0.15s later for 50% damage. No effect on Rapid Fire's chaos beam. Echoes don't echo, split or leave pull zones, and aren't primary hits.

cards.name: Glass Blood
cards.face: Bleed-killed foes burst: fragments hurt + Bleed
cards.detail: Enemies killed by Bleed burst into fragments that damage and inflict Bleed on nearby enemies. Each outbreak spreads at most two hops.

cards.name: Silver Skin
cards.face: After a level-up, block the next hit.

cards.name: Fracture Shot
cards.face: Each shot splits 3 ways
cards.detail: Each shot splits into 3 branches over 30°, then 5 over 60°, 9 over 120°, 17 over 180°. The shot's damage is shared evenly across all its branches (the center included); several branches can hit one enemy. Fans never spread past 90° to either side.

cards.name: Red Smile
cards.face: Every 10s: 3s of Void melee. 2× damage + Bleed.
cards.detail: Every 10s in combat, become the Thing From Below for 3s. Replace projectile attacks with sweeping melee attacks that deal 200% of projectile damage as Void damage and always inflict Bleed. Requires both Bleed and Void signatures. Existing projectiles remain active during transformation. Sweeps strike in your last move direction. They count as primary hits, not shots or projectiles.

cards.name: False Opening
cards.face: A sharp turn leaves a delayed Void pulse.
cards.detail: A sharp turn while moving marks the spot. 0.3s later it pulses, dealing 12 damage to enemies within 72pt and slowing them 30% for 1.2s. 1.1s cooldown.

cards.name: Everglow
cards.face: Become the fire at the center of the arena.
cards.detail: Every 2s, a pulse deals 50% ATK to nearby enemies. T2 doubles its radius. T3: each hit you take adds +1% pulse damage, up to +100%. T4 doubles pulse damage, and each hit you take adds +0.5% ATK, up to +50%. T5: every 20s, after a short warning, erupt for 500% ATK across the whole arena. The pulse skips bosses; mini-bosses take half. Bosses and mini-bosses take half eruption damage.

tiers.face: Inner Heat: pulse every 2s for 50% ATK nearby
Ragekindled: getting hit grows the pulse
Living Furnace: pulse ×2; getting hit grows ATK

cards.name: Iron Maiden
cards.face: Turn every impact into stored punishment.
cards.detail: Thorns deal 5 damage to enemies that touch you (17 from T2). Damaging hits store energy: 4 release a 200% DEF burst, and T5 fires what's stored at a priority foe every 20s. The +5% and +15% DEF are one-time grants of at least +1. Retaliate has a 1s cooldown. Bosses and mini-bosses take 50% less thorn and Retaliate damage.

tiers.face: Iron Skin: DEF fuels damage; +5% DEF; Thorns bite touchers
Iron Maiden: +15% DEF; energy fires every 20s

cards.name: Skybeam
cards.face: Lasso your prey. Call judgment from above.
cards.detail: The lasso tethers the nearest foe in reach and deals 15% ATK Shock each second (T2: 30% ATK, double reach). T4: after 2s on the same prey, it takes +35% damage from all sources. T5: every 5s, a strike lands 1s after its warning: 300% ATK to the lassoed prey (or the nearest target), and 150% ATK to every other enemy within 80pt. Bosses and mini-bosses take half Skybeam damage and half the +35%.

tiers.face: Lightning Lasso: tether the nearest foe for 15% ATK Shock/s
Extended Circuit: lasso damage and range doubled
Homing Beacon: your shots favor the lassoed prey
Heaven's Call: prey lassoed 2s takes +35% damage
Skybeam: every 5s a 300% ATK strike with splash

cards.name: Apex
cards.face: Feed the familiar. Become the hunt.
cards.detail: The bat heals you for half its damage. T2: +5 max HP per 10 kills (up to +100); 1% of max HP adds to ATK. T3: bites execute normal enemies below 20% HP. T5: shots, bat bites and Red Smile sweeps charge a 4-step gauge; when full, the bat executes the nearest weakened enemy (2s cooldown): normal enemies below 50% HP, bosses and mini-bosses at 10% or less. Bosses and mini-bosses take half bat damage and half the Marked bonus.

tiers.face: Blood Familiar: an invulnerable bat hunts; kills grow its bite
Bloodfed: +5 max HP per 10 kills; HP feeds ATK
Bloodhound: bat favors bleeders, executes the weak
Marked: bosses at once, foes after 10s: +35%
The Hunter: hits charge an execute pounce

cards.name: Erasure
cards.face: Destabilize reality. Accept the final cost.
cards.detail: Lurch cooldown: 2s, or 1.2s from T2. T5 in Arenas 1-10: 37.5s, then 52.5s.

tiers.face: Unstable: hits charge the void; full meter → a lurch (a lone boss: 50%)
Void-Touched: ignore shields; lurch more often
Rift Cannon: every 3rd lurch, a 300% ATK beam
Echo: shots echo 1.5s later from afar (50% damage)
Event Horizon: a timer erases the arena, then you

cards.name: Polar Vortex
cards.face: Carry the storm. Freeze enemies to the soul.
cards.detail: Impaired: slowed, frozen or stunned. T3: the storm follows you and adds 1 Chill a second. T4: the icicle (200% damage) replaces your shot; Erasure's Echo stops. T4 is mutually exclusive with Warp Shot, Gravity Well, Mirror Edge, Fracture Shot and Riftline: whichever side you own first blocks the other. T5: 5 Chill freezes an enemy for 3s; then it takes +100% damage for 4s. Mini-bosses are slowed 85% instead of frozen, then take +50%. The storm ignores bosses.

tiers.face: Iceburst: chilled foes that die burst into 3 ice shards
Brittle Cold: 5 shards; +40% vs impaired foes

synergies.title: Spreading Flame
synergies.effect: Burns leap to nearby enemies

synergies.title: Wildfire Heart
synergies.effect: Burns last 4s, spread farther and hit harder

synergies.title: Inferno Crown
synergies.effect: Non-boss enemies take fire damage over time

synergies.title: Chain Current
synergies.effect: Lightning chains to 1 additional enemy

synergies.title: Tesla Field
synergies.effect: A charged aura damages nearby enemies

synergies.title: Storm Engine
synergies.effect: Every 3rd shot fires a chaining spread

synergies.title: Open Wounds
synergies.effect: Bleeding enemies take 25% more damage

synergies.title: Exsanguinate
synergies.effect: Enemies below 25% HP take 2× damage

synergies.title: Red Harvest
synergies.effect: Killing a bleeding enemy restores 1 HP

synergies.title: Ironhide
synergies.effect: Nearby enemies cut damage taken, up to 90%

synergies.title: Thornwall
synergies.effect: Reflect 150% of contact damage; bosses take half

synergies.title: Unbroken Core
synergies.effect: Survive a lethal hit: 10s invulnerable, +ATK equal to DEF. A shield blocks projectiles.

synergies.title: Blackhole
synergies.effect: Every 5th primary volley creates a black hole. Your black holes absorb hostile projectiles and impair enemy movement.

synergies.title: Listlessness
synergies.effect: Enemies entering your black holes become trapped (elites for half as long; bosses never). Absorbed hostile projectiles return toward enemies, infused with Void.

synergies.title: Singularity
synergies.effect: Trapped enemies decompose: normal enemies until they die, elites up to 20% max HP per trap. Bosses caught in a black hole take 1% max HP per second.

synergies.title: Frostbite
synergies.effect: Chilled enemies move even slower

synergies.title: Shatter
synergies.effect: Slowed foes may shatter (elites: 20% HP)

synergies.title: Absolute Zero
synergies.effect: Non-boss foes slow; shatters come easy

synergies.title: Rootbound
synergies.effect: Cultivated ground grips harder — enemies on it are slower

synergies.title: Verdant Rise
synergies.effect: Your ground heals 3 HP per tick

synergies.title: Wildwood
synergies.effect: The whole garden bites what stands on it
